mistakes.text: If she is a robot, she wouldn't mind the requests.
mistakes.normalized: if she is a robot she wouldn't mind the requests
mistakes.feedback_sk: Situácia je nereálna, preto v Second Conditional patrí po „if“ „were“, nie „is“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Situace je nereálná, proto ve Second Conditional patří po „if“ „were“, ne „is“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The situation is unreal, so Second Conditional uses “were” after “if”, not “is”.

mistakes.text: If she would be a robot, she wouldn't mind the requests.
mistakes.normalized: if she would be a robot she wouldn't mind the requests
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Second Conditional sa po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správne je „if she were“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ve Second Conditional se po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správně je „if she were“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In Second Conditional don't use “would” after “if”; say “if she were”.

mistakes.text: If she were a robot, she won't mind the requests.
mistakes.normalized: if she were a robot she won't mind the requests
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nereálny následok vyjadruje „would“: „she wouldn't mind“, nie „won't mind“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nereálný následek vyjadřuje „would“: „she wouldn't mind“, ne „won't mind“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An unreal result needs “would”: “she wouldn't mind”, not “won't mind”.

mistakes.text: If she were robot, she wouldn't mind the requests.
mistakes.normalized: if she were robot she wouldn't mind the requests
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri povolaní či druhu v jednotnom čísle treba člen: „a robot“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U povolání či druhu v jednotném čísle je potřeba člen: „a robot“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A singular countable noun needs an article: “a robot”.

mistakes.text: If she were a robot, the requests wouldn't mind her.
mistakes.normalized: if she were a robot the requests wouldn't mind her
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri „mind“ je podmetom osoba: „she wouldn't mind the requests“ alebo „wouldn't bother her“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U „mind“ je podmětem osoba: „she wouldn't mind the requests“ nebo „wouldn't bother her“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With “mind” the person is the subject: “she wouldn't mind the requests”.
